title: [weak self] in Stored Closures

docs.title: ARC — Strong Reference Cycles for Closures

hints: A stored closure that captures `self` strongly creates a cycle.
Add a capture list with `weak self` and unwrap it at the start of the closure.
`onTick = { [weak self] in guard let self else { return }; count += 1; log.lines.append("tick \(count)") }`.
